dataset.prior_consumption: Original 37-symbol data consumed in legacy and initial campaigns; BTC/ETH historical download is not a fresh holdout

hypothesis.discriminator: Unlike raw-volume shock/reversal, low-volume dislocation reversal or price momentum, this ranks sustained signed close location weighted by volume and rejects configurations that substantially reproduce trailing-return ranks.
hypothesis.entry: rank on the prior closed UTC-day bar; execute next open
hypothesis.failure: signed-flow proxy is absent, unstable, a momentum relabel, concentrated, market-exposed or consumed by daily turnover
hypothesis.feature: rolling sum of candle close-location value times base volume divided by rolling base volume
hypothesis.mechanism: Persistent informed flow may repeatedly close high-volume bars near their directional extreme, with inventory adjustment continuing into the next day.
hypothesis.portfolio: daily long two highest- and short two lowest-pressure non-BTC/ETH symbols at fixed rank weights

inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across both frozen lookback variants

limitations: universe selected in September 2026, survivorship/selection bias
no historical L2, queue, trade-side flow or point-in-time instrument rules
OHLCV volume is total base volume, not aggressive buy volume
fee tiers are a dated observed account schedule, not a historical fee time series
instrument minimums are current snapshots, not point-in-time historical rules
spread assumptions are max(3bps, old snapshot median), not observed historical spreads
funding uses settled historical rates and entry-notional approximation; historical mark missing
BTC/ETH fees are conservative explicit proxies, not measured account-specific history
BTC/ETH spread is max(3bps, one current snapshot); not historical L2 spread
reused consumed data is not fresh validation
current universe selection creates survivorship bias
OHLCV close location is only a proxy and does not identify aggressor-side trade flow
base volume is not comparable economic notional across symbols but only weights bars within each symbol
current fees, spreads and instrument rules approximate history
daily taker turnover is deliberately charged; no maker or queue inference
selection: no within-search winner selection; both lookbacks evaluated on every forward fold and Holm-corrected
